description: [FREE: 25 calls/day, then $0.002 USDC per call via x402] Searches every paid API listed in the public x402 directories (Coinbase CDP and PayAI, about 100,000 endpoints) and ranks the providers by what LogicNodes measures itself: whether the endpoint really answers with valid x402 payment terms (checked around the clock), uptime over 72 hours, USDC its payout address received on Base in the last 7 days and distinct payers. Returns matching endpoints with price, networks, method and an example input, so an agent can call the best one directly. Filter by network (CAIP-2), maximum price and live-only.

liveOnly.description: true: only providers whose last check returned valid x402 terms; false: everything; default: leave out providers whose last check failed (not-yet-checked ones are included, with checkedAt null, after the live ones)

maxPriceUsd.description: only providers with an endpoint at or below this price

network.description: only providers that accept payment on this CAIP-2 network, e.g. eip155:8453

query.description: what you need, e.g. "web scraping", "weather", "token price"

name: x402_service_search
title: Find a paid API for a task (ranked x402 services)
